description: Changes a project's title, subtitle, description, slug, detail values, categories, or cover photo. Use it to fill in or correct a project, e.g. with details from the old site. Pass only what changes: details merge (null clears one), categories replace the project's categories, and a new title keeps the slug unless you pass one (changing a slug breaks links to the old project page).

categories.description: The project's categories (replacing the current ones): names, slugs, or ids; missing names are created, e.g. ["Custom Homes"].

cover.description: Item id of a photo in this project (from list_projects with project), or null to use its first ready photo, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

description.description: Plain text shown on the project page (cards show its start), e.g. "A two-story custom home with an arched entry."; null clears it.

details.description: Detail values by key (see get_project_details): numbers as numbers (the unit is separate), select as an option value, dates as YYYY-MM-DD, links as URLs; null clears one, e.g. { "square_footage": 3200, "year": 2024 }.

project.description: The project to change (slug, title, or id), e.g. "arched-entry-two-story".

showcaseId.description: Projects showcase id from list_showcases, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

slug.description: New URL form, only when the user wants it changed, e.g. "arched-entry".

subtitle.description: The line under the title, often type and location, e.g. "Custom Home · Zebulon, NC"; null clears it.

name: update_project
title: Update project
